title: Sanitar tozalash, qattiq maishiy chiqindilarni yig‘ish va tashish jarayonlarini raqamlashtirish uchun dispetcherlik-boshqaruv veb-platformasini ishlab chiqish, joriy etish va ishga tushirish.

subject_uz: Sanitar tozalash va chiqindi tashishni raqamlashtirish uchun haydovchi mobil ilovasi, mavjud GPS tizimini GIS xaritaga ulash va dispetcherlik-boshqaruv veb-platformasini ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Haydovchilar uchun Android mobil ilova ishlab chiqilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: An Android mobile app for drivers must be developed.
requirements.quote: Android операцион тизимида ишлайдиган мобил илова ишлаб чикиш.

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi mavjud GPS provayder va qurilmalarini almashtirmasdan ularni tizimga ulashi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must integrate the existing GPS devices and provider without replacing them.
requirements.quote: Mashinalarda o'rnatilgan GPS trackerlar almashtirilmaydi va ularning sozlamalari

requirements.summary_uz: Maxsus GPS qurilmalari, SIM-kartalar va telefonlar sotib olish xaridga kirmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Purchase of GPS trackers, SIM cards and phones is outside the scope of the procurement.
requirements.quote: GPS trekerlar, telefonlar va boshqa jihozlarni sotib olish

requirements.summary_uz: Ma'lumotlar O'zbekiston hududidagi serverlarda saqlanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Data must be stored on servers located in Uzbekistan.
requirements.quote: Ma'lumotlar O'zbekiston hududidagi serverlarda saqlanadi; mexanizm loyiha

requirements.summary_uz: Kiberxavfsizlik ekspertizasi, attestatsiya va sertifikatlash xizmatlari va ularning to'lovlari ijrochi hisobiga loyiha doirasiga kiradi.
requirements.summary_en: Cybersecurity expert review, attestation and certification services and their fees fall within the project scope.
requirements.quote: kiberxavfsizlik ekspertizasi, attestatsiya va sertifikatlash xizmatlari hamda ularning to'lovlari loyiha doirasi ichiga kiradi

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlab chiqilgan dasturning manba kodi to'liq to'lovdan keyin buyurtmachiga topshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: The source code is handed to the customer after full payment.
requirements.quote: Manba kodi to'liq to'lov amalga oshirilgandan keyin buyurtrnachiga topshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriq mavjud Tozalive platformasi ustiga yangi modullar qo'shishni nazarda tutadi (mavjud autentifikatsiya va API shlyuzi qayta ishlatiladi).
requirements.summary_en: The specification builds new modules on top of the existing Tozalive platform, reusing its authentication and API gateway.
requirements.quote: Loyiha noldan boshlanmaydi. Ijrochi tomonidan Tozalive platformasi ishlab chiqilgan

requirements.summary_uz: Tizim qabul qilingan sanadan boshlab kamida 6 oy bepul kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The system must be supported free of charge for at least 6 months from acceptance.
requirements.quote: Тизим цабул цилинган санадан бошлаб камида б ой кафолат хак олмасдан хизмат к}рсатилиши.

requirements.summary_uz: Buyurtmachi bosqich demosini 7 ish kuni ichida qabul qilmasa yoki izoh bermasa, bosqich qabul qilingan hisoblanadi.
requirements.summary_en: If the customer does not respond within 7 working days, a stage is deemed accepted.
requirements.quote: 7 ish kuni ichida javob kelmasa, bosqich qabul qilingan hisoblanadi

requirements.summary_uz: Taklifda tizimning funksional tavsifi va arxitekturasi taqdim etilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The proposal must describe the system's functions and architecture.
requirements.quote: Таклиф этилаётган тизимнинг функционал тавсифи ва архитектураси

flags.quote: Loyiha noldan boshlanmaydi. Ijrochi tomonidan Tozalive platformasi ishlab chiqilgan
flags.explanation_uz: Texnik topshiriq yangi tizimni mavjud Tozalive platformasi ustiga quradi va bu platforma ijrochi tomonidan ishlab chiqilgani hamda ishlab turgani aytiladi; mavjud autentifikatsiya, API shlyuzi va joylashtirish jarayoni qayta ishlatilishi nazarda tutilgan. Bunday shartlarda boshqa ishlab chiquvchi loyihani noldan bajarishi va shu asosda raqobatlasha olishi qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The specification builds the new system on the existing Tozalive platform and states it was developed by the contractor and is already in production, with its authentication, API gateway and deployment reused. Under these terms another developer may find it hard to deliver from scratch and compete on equal terms.
flags.rewrite_uz: Texnik topshiriqda mavjud tizim bilan integratsiya uchun zarur API va hujjatlar barcha ishtirokchilarga e'lon bilan birga taqdim etilsin va yangi tizim mustaqil, ochiq interfeyslar orqali ishlashi mumkinligi yozilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: State that the APIs and documentation of the existing system needed for integration are provided to all bidders with the notice, and that the new system may be built independently using open interfaces.
flags.type_label_uz: Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart
flags.type_label_en: Other clause that may limit competition
flags.category_uz: Muayyan ishtirokchilar uchun ustunlik yaratish (Raqobat qo'mitasi tasnifi, 2025)
flags.category_en: Creation of advantages for specific bidders (Competition Committee category, 2025)

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (45-bet): Texnik topshiriq yangi tizimni mavjud Tozalive platformasi ustiga quradi va bu platforma ijrochi tomonidan ishlab chiqilgani hamda ishlab turgani aytiladi; mavjud autentifikatsiya, API shlyuzi va joylashtirish jarayoni qayta ishlatilishi nazarda tutilgan. Bunday shartlarda boshqa ishlab chiquvchi loyihani noldan bajarishi va shu asosda raqobatlasha olishi qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
Diqqat: hujjatning 2 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 45): The specification builds the new system on the existing Tozalive platform and states it was developed by the contractor and is already in production, with its authentication, API gateway and deployment reused. Under these terms another developer may find it hard to deliver from scratch and compete on equal terms.
Note: 2 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
